basics.name: Shruthi Kodati
basics.title: Full Stack Developer & Computer Science Graduate Student
basics.summary: Computer Science graduate student with hands-on experience in full stack development, building scalable web applications and RESTful APIs using Python, Flask, and JavaScript. Focused on building scalable systems and high-quality user experiences. Experienced in building scalable data pipelines and backend systems for large-scale structured and unstructured datasets. Proficient in Python and SQL, with hands-on expertise in ETL development, data modeling, query optimization, and deploying data-intensive applications to production.

experience.company: College of Nursing | University of Illinois- Chicago
bullets: Architected and developed a full-stack web application using Python, Flask, RESTful APIs, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and SQL, reducing manual dietary planning effort by 40% through automated data processing and structured CRUD workflows.
Optimized backend API performance by implementing efficient routing, database queries, and structured data handling, decreasing average response time by 35% and improving data retrieval consistency.

Deployed and maintained a cloud-hosted application on Render using Git/GitHub-based CI/CD workflows, maintaining uptime, ensuring high availability, and reducing deployment errors through version-controlled releases.

experience.company: Housing Facilities | University of Illinois- Chicago
bullets: Resolved and supported 50–70 weekly system-driven service requests, reducing average ticket resolution time by 30% through structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
Identified recurring workflow inefficiencies and validation gaps, contributing to a 20% reduction in repeat service incidents.
Maintained operational logs and technical documentation improving audit traceability, cross-team collaboration, and process reliability across cross-functional production teams.

Developed and enhanced CRM features using Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC), applying object-oriented programming principles to automate business workflows that reduced manual processing steps by 30%.
Integrated external systems using REST APIs, JSON, and OAuth 2.0, improving secure data exchange and increasing cross-system data accuracy by 25%.
Debugged, tested, and deployed enhancements using Salesforce CLI, Git, and VS Code, improving feature release turnaround time by 20% through structured testing and version control.

projects.title: Multi-Modal RAG for SEC 10-K Financial Document Analysis
bullets: Architected and deployed a full-stack financial document analysis platform processing 150 SEC 10-K filings (8GB, 45K text chunks, 12K tables), building RESTful APIs with Flask for query routing, retrieval, and citation-backed responses.
Designed hybrid dense + sparse retrieval (FAISS + BM25) with structured table-aware indexing, improving Table Recall@5 to 85% and increasing Exact Match by 12 points over text-only baselines.
Integrated responsive frontend with optimized backend services, achieving 4.2s median latency, and deployed the end-to-end system with version-controlled releases.

projects.title: San Francisco Property Tax Analysis and Gentrification Study
bullets: Developed a full-stack web application processing 3.7M property tax records (6GB GeoJSON) with backend REST APIs for dynamic filtering, aggregation, and geospatial analytics.

Engineered optimized ETL pipeline using streaming and memory-efficient data processing, reducing memory usage by 87% (5.7GB → 733MB), enabling scalable backend processing and improved system responsiveness.
Built interactive frontend dashboards supporting neighborhood-level exploration across 93 districts, deploying a structured client-server architecture for large-scale data visualization.

otherProjects.title: Chicago Traffic Crashes: Predictive Safety Analytics
bullets: Analyzed 938K crash records with 48 features, building ensemble models (Random Forest, XGBoost, Neural Networks) achieving 0.597 RMSE for injury prediction.
Discovered 90% pedestrian injury rate and identified highest-risk corridors.
Deployed interactive dashboards on GitHub Pages with Plotly/Folium; implemented DBSCAN clustering for geographic hotspot identification.

otherProjects.title: Fairness in Targeted Advertisements
bullets: Built comprehensive fairness evaluation framework addressing bias in targeted advertising by combining Meta's Ad Library (66K employment ads), FairJobs benchmark dataset (1M+ rows), and custom synthetic data.
Achieved 93.4% reduction in statistical parity difference while maintaining 99.2% accuracy, and improved Disparate Impact Ratio from non-compliant 0.70 to near-compliant 0.98.
Implemented multiple mitigation strategies including Reweighing, Adversarial Debiasing, and Threshold Optimization using Fairlearn and AIF360.
Published 11-page ACM research paper with mathematical formalization, ablation studies across three datasets, and statistical significance testing.
